verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your own infrastructure, with your own servers, browsers and LLM API keys. The llms.txt probe describes it as open-source, and a community comment confirms the code is published under AGPL3, which some employers may find restrictive. Missing for 10: deployment detail in the evidence (install steps, Docker or other requirements), clarity on whether self-hosted matches Cloud features (the SDK docs reference a cloud Chromium instance and a Cloud UI), and any independent hands-on report of a self-hosted run.
